import os, glob
found = [p for pat in ('**/*.csv','**/*.tsv','**/*.xlsx','**/*.parquet')
         for p in glob.glob(pat, recursive=True)
         if not any(x in p for x in ('/.cache','site-packages','/.ipython'))]
print("tabular data files:", found or "NONE")
print("workspace:", sorted(os.listdir('.')))
```
